dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Thanks be to the Anemo Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I'm praying to Lord Barbatos. It was by his protection that Mondstadt was able to weather this storm.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: We also have him to thank for the safety of the Knights of Favonius and the adventurers of the Guild.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: I dare not fathom the things Lord Barbatos has done for us.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: But just knowing that such a diligent deity watches over Mondstadt sets my heart at ease.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Ah, yes. If you have some time, could you do me a favor?

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: I'd like you to help me collect one batch of Dandelion Seeds, and scatter them to the winds at the top of the Anemo Archon Statue...
